title: Unani Ayurvedic and Homoeopathic Practitioners Amendment Ordinance 1982

sections.shortTitle: Unani Ayurvedic and Homoeopathic Practitioners Amendment Ordinance 1982
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXVII OF 1982
UNANI, AYURVEDIC
AND HOMOEOPATHIC PRACTITIONERS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1982
ORDINANCE XXVII OF
1982
An Ordinance further to amend the Unani, Ayurvedic and Homoeopathic
Practitioners Act, 1965
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 31st October, 1982]
No. F. 17(1)/82-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
l. Short title and
commencement.-(1) This Ordinance may be called the Unani, Ayurvedic and
Homoeopathic Practitioners (Amendment) Ordinance, 1982.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Unani Ayurvedic and Homoeopathic Practitioners Amendment Ordinance 1982
sections.description:
Amendment of section 2, Act II of 1965

ORDINANCE XXVII OF 1982
UNANI, AYURVEDIC
AND HOMOEOPATHIC PRACTITIONERS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1982
ORDINANCE XXVII OF
1982
An Ordinance further to amend the Unani, Ayurvedic and Homoeopathic
Practitioners Act, 1965
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 31st October, 1982]
No. F. 17(1)/82-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
2. Amendment of section 2, Act
II of 1965.-In the Unani, Ayurvedic and Homoeopethic Practitioners Act,
1965 (II of 1965), hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in section 2, for
clauses (b) and (bb) the following shall be substituted, namely :-
"(b)
"Committee" means the Committee appointed by the Council ;
(bb)
"Council" means the National Council for Tibb or, as the case may be
the National Council for Homoeopathy, established under section 3;"

Amendment of section 3, Act II of 1965

ORDINANCE XXVII OF 1982
UNANI, AYURVEDIC
AND HOMOEOPATHIC PRACTITIONERS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1982
ORDINANCE XXVII OF
1982
An Ordinance further to amend the Unani, Ayurvedic and Homoeopathic
Practitioners Act, 1965
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 31st October, 1982]
No. F. 17(1)/82-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
3. Amendment of section 3, Act
II of 1965.-In the said Act, in section 3, in subsection (1), or the words
"a Board to be called the Board of Homoeo pathic System of Medicine"
the words "another Council to be called the National Council for
Homoeopathy " shall be substituted.
